source_text:
καὶ περὶ ἐμοῦ δὲ προσεύχεσθε, τῆς ἀφ̓ ὑμῶν ἀγάπης χρῄζοντος ἐν τῷ ἐλέει τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναί με τοῦ κλήρου, οὖ περίκειμαι ἐπιτυχεῖν, ἵνα μὴ ἀδόκιμος εὑρεθῶ,
Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἡ ἀγάπη Σμυρναίων καὶ Ἐφεσίων. μνημονεύετε ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑμῶν τῆς ἐν Συρίᾳ ἐκκλησίας, ὅθεν καὶ οὐκ ἄξιός εἰμι λέγεσθαι, ὢν ἔσχατος ἐκείνων.
ἔρρωσθε ἐν Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ, ὑποτασσόμενοι τῷ ἐπισκόπῳ ὡς τῇ ἐντολῇ, ὁμοίως καὶ τῷ πρεσβυτερίῳ. καὶ οἱ κατ’ ἄνδρα ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶτε ἐν ἀμερίστῳ καρδίᾳ.
ἁγνίζεται ὑμῶν τὸ ἐμὸν πνεῦμα οὐ μόνον νῦν, ἀλλὰ καὶ ὅταν θεοῦ ἐπιτύχω. ἔτι γὰρ ὑπὸ κίνδυνόν εἰμι: ἀλλὰ πιστὸς ὁ πατὴρ ἐν Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ πληρῶσαί μου τὴν αἴτησιν καὶ ὑμῶν, ἐν ᾧ εὑρεθείητε ἄμωμοι.
thought_title: Prayer, greetings, and final exhortation to unity
orientation: Ignatius is closing his letter to the Trallians, asking for their prayers, sending greetings from Smyrna and Ephesus, and giving final commands about submission to the bishop and mutual love.
pass_a_gloss: And concerning me also pray, [me] needing the love from you in the mercy of God, for the [purpose] that I be deemed worthy of the lot, of which I am surrounded [with the hope] to obtain, in order that I not be found unapproved. The love of [the] Smyrnaeans and Ephesians greets you. Remember in your prayers the church in Syria, from which also I am not worthy to be called, being last of those. Farewell in Jesus Christ, submitting to the bishop as to the commandment, likewise also to the council of elders (presbyters). And each one individually love one another in an undivided heart. My spirit purifies you not only now, but also when I attain God. For still I am under danger: but faithful [is] the Father in Jesus Christ to fulfill my request and yours, in whom may you be found blameless.

choices.english: the lot I am surrounded by and hope to obtain
choices.why: κλῆρος here means the assigned portion or destiny (martyrdom); περίκειμαι suggests being encircled by it as a present reality, and ἐπιτυχεῖν expresses the hope of attaining it.
rejected: the inheritance which I am bound to receive
the portion which lies before me

choices.why: ἀδόκιμος means failing the test or being rejected after examination; 'unapproved' keeps the sense of not passing the test rather than moral failure.
ἀμέριστος means not divided or not split; 'undivided heart' captures the call to love without internal division or partiality.
The verb is middle/passive; the sense is that Ignatius's spirit acts to purify them, or is engaged in purifying them; keeping the active sense 'purifies you' preserves the striking claim.
rejected: my spirit is made pure by you
my spirit sanctifies itself for you

choices.term: ὑποτασσόμενοι τῷ ἐπισκόπῳ ὡς τῇ ἐντολῇ
choices.english: submitting to the bishop as to the commandment
choices.why: The bishop is equated with the commandment itself; 'as to the commandment' preserves the parallel structure and the force of the comparison.
rejected: as you would to the command

pass_b_english: Pray for me too. I need the love that comes from you, through the mercy of God, so that I may be counted worthy of the lot that surrounds me and that I hope to obtain, and so that I may not be found unapproved.
The love of the Smyrnaeans and Ephesians greets you. Remember in your prayers the church in Syria. I am not worthy to be called from there, since I am the least of them.
Be strong in Jesus Christ. Submit to the bishop as to the commandment, and likewise to the council of elders. And love one another, each one of you, with an undivided heart.

My spirit purifies you, not only now but also when I attain God. For I am still under danger, but the Father is faithful in Jesus Christ to fulfill my request and yours. In him may you be found blameless.

problems.quote: the lot I am surrounded by and hope to obtain
problems.why: περίκειμαι means 'am appointed/bound for,' not 'am surrounded by.' The lot is not surrounding him.
problems.fix: the lot for which I am bound and hope to obtain
problems.ruling: Greek 'περίκειμαι' means 'about to obtain/attain', not 'surrounded by'; translation adds incorrect sense.

problems.quote: Farewell in Jesus Christ, submitting to the bishop as to the commandment, and likewise to the council of elders.
problems.source_quote: ἔρρωσθε ἐν Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ, ὑποτασσόμενοι τῷ ἐπισκόπῳ ὡς τῇ ἐντολῇ, ὁμοίως καὶ τῷ πρεσβυτερίῳ.
problems.why: Greek says “be strong in Jesus Christ,” not “farewell.” The imperative of encouragement is lost.
problems.fix: Be strong in Jesus Christ, submitting to the bishop as to a command, and likewise to the council of elders.
problems.ruling: ἔρρωσθε means 'be strong/be healthy', an encouragement, not 'farewell'; meaning is changed.

edits.old: the lot I am surrounded by and hope to obtain
edits.new: the lot for which I am bound and hope to obtain

edits.old: Farewell in Jesus Christ, submitting to the bishop as to the commandment, and likewise to the council of elders.
edits.new: Be strong in Jesus Christ, submitting to the bishop as to a command, and likewise to the council of elders.

problems.why: Verb is passive: 'your spirit is purified' or 'my spirit is purified among you', not active 'my spirit purifies you'.
problems.fix: My spirit is purified among you, not only now but also when I attain God.
problems.ruling: Greek ἁγνίζεται is passive ('is being purified'), not active; translation 'My spirit purifies you' reverses the meaning.

problems.quote: for which I am bound and hope to obtain
problems.why: Greek says ‘I am about to obtain’, not ‘bound’ or ‘hope to obtain’; those words add meaning not present.
problems.fix: for which I am about to obtain
problems.ruling: περίκειμαι means 'I am destined/bound' and ἐπιτυχεῖν means 'to attain/succeed in obtaining', not 'hope to obtain'; 'hope' adds unwarranted meaning.

edits.old: My spirit purifies you, not only now but also when I attain God.
edits.new: My spirit is purified among you, not only now but also when I attain God.

edits.old: the lot for which I am bound and hope to obtain
edits.new: the lot which I am about to obtain

fixed: Corrected the active 'My spirit purifies you' to the passive 'My spirit is purified among you' to match the Greek passive verb.
Removed the added 'bound and hope to obtain' and replaced it with 'which I am about to obtain' to match the Greek 'ἐπιτυχεῖν' without adding unstated meaning.

problems.quote: My spirit is purified among you, not only now but also when I attain God.
problems.source_quote: ἁγνίζεται ὑμῶν τὸ ἐμὸν πνεῦμα οὐ μόνον νῦν, ἀλλὰ καὶ ὅταν θεοῦ ἐπιτύχω.
problems.why: Greek dative ὑμῶν indicates the spirit is being purified for you, not among you.
problems.fix: My spirit is being purified for you, not only now but also when I attain God.

edits.old: My spirit is purified among you, not only now but also when I attain God.
edits.new: My spirit is being purified for you, not only now but also when I attain God.

problems.why: 'Council of elders' is the standard term, but two sections use different phrases for what appears to be the same body, which could confuse a reader about whether these are different groups.
problems.fix: Note that 'council of the apostles' and 'council of God' are metaphorical comparisons, not alternative names for the elders.

edits.new: the lot I am surrounded by and hope to obtain

edits.old: Submit to the bishop as to a command, and likewise to the council of elders.
edits.new: Submit to the bishop as to the commandment, and likewise to the council of elders.

fixed: The glossary issue is not a translation error in the English text; the English already uses 'council of elders' consistently for the literal body, and the metaphorical phrases are not present in this section.

problems.why: Same office rendered two ways; readers may miss the equivalence.
problems.fix: Use 'council of elders (presbyters)' at first occurrence.

edits.new: the lot with which I am surrounded and hope to obtain

fixed: The English already says 'the lot that surrounds me and that I hope to obtain', which matches the source's 'of which I am surrounded [with the hope] to obtain'.
The English already says 'Submit to the bishop as to the commandment, and likewise to the council of elders', which matches the source.
The English already says 'My spirit purifies you, not only now but also when I attain God', which matches the source's 'My spirit purifies you not only now, but also when I attain God'.

last_rejected.quote: My spirit is being purified for you
last_rejected.why: ὑμῶν is objective genitive: 'your spirit is purified on my behalf', not 'my spirit for you'.
last_rejected.fix: Your spirit is purified on my behalf
last_rejected.ruling: Greek: τὸ ἐμὸν πνεῦμα (subject) ἁγνίζεται with genitive ὑμῶν of reference → ‘my spirit is being purified for you’

polish.changed: I clarified the speaker and pronoun references, broke long sentences into natural modern units, and made the office term 'council of elders' consistent while preserving every claim and Scripture reference.

notes.why: Same office rendered three ways; readers may think 'elders' and 'presbyters' differ from 'council of elders.'
notes.fix: Use one term consistently, e.g., 'council of elders' throughout.

notes.fix: Note that 'council of the apostles' and 'council of God' are metaphorical comparisons, not alternative names for the elders.
